facts.fact: BusinessDay reports the CBN directive, issued in June 2026, requires financial institutions and payment participants (banks, fintechs, mobile money operators, switching and processing companies, payment service providers) to store and manage payment transaction data generated in Nigeria in Nigeria, with a deadline of 1 January 2027.

The directive was issued by the Central Bank of Nigeria for the financial institutions and payment operators it licenses; banks and fintechs interviewed say they have been unable to get clarity from the CBN on hybrid cloud arrangements.

systems.tiers: national; banks, fintechs, mobile money operators, switches, payment service providers
